answer: Each identity claims one canyon chain on a ridge register, posting an 85-credit bond. It finishes five linked tasks, sealing each link with its sable key; the ridge register publishes link hashes, so each task needs the prior output. A canyon auditor recomputes it and checks each sable seal against its key; a broken or reused link burns the bond. First filing 35 credits, kth 35+6(k-1), 1000th 6029, 1000 fakes 3,032,000 plus 85,000 locked. A rented-chain ring fails, since a chain sealed for one key cannot replay under another. An honest agent pays 35 once and recovers 85 after a clean epoch.
